scenes.bubble: We email PDFs. Isn't that e‑invoicing?
scenes.caption: A common assumption in finance teams.
scenes.say: Myth or fact? If we email our invoices as PDFs, we're already doing e-invoicing.
cap: If we email invoices as *PDFs*, we're already doing *e‑invoicing*.

scenes.desc: An e‑invoice is structured data, exchanged through accredited providers. A PDF is not an e‑invoice.
scenes.src: UAE Electronic Invoicing Guidelines V2.0, UAE Ministry of Finance, 26 Oct 2026, ss. 3, 5.3 and 10.2.1; checked 29 Oct 2026. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: Fact: under the U.A.E. system, an e-invoice is structured data in X.M.L., sent through accredited service providers. A PDF doesn't count.
cap: Fact: under the UAE system, an e‑invoice is *structured data* in XML, sent through accredited service providers.

scenes.say: So start with your data. Check which fields you hold today, and whether your E.R.P. can produce them.
cap: Check which fields you hold today, and whether your ERP can produce them.
